message: The other day, I found myself reminiscing about fire drills from my school days, you know, the ones that felt like an annoying interruption? Well, I decided to turn it into a little family game. We practiced our escape plan while pretending we were on a treasure hunt! It was surprisingly fun and a great reminder that low-tech activities can bring us together while keeping safety in mind. Have you rediscovered any old-school fun lately? 🔍
